meta.title: Chat file preview
meta.description: Preview uploaded and delivered documents, images, audio, and video in chat. Existing file cards, downloads, and system actions stay unchanged.

missing: This file is missing or you don’t have access.
tooLarge: This file exceeds the preview limit for its format.
unsupported: This format isn’t supported in chat preview yet.
unreadable: Can’t preview: the file is damaged or doesn’t match its extension.
unavailable: Couldn’t read the attachment. Try again.
encoding: This text encoding isn’t supported. Use UTF-8 or UTF-16 with a BOM.
tableLimit: Showing only the first 200 rows and 64 columns.
pdfLocked: This PDF is password protected and can’t be previewed.
changed: The file changed while being read. Try again.
mediaError: Can’t play this file: its codec isn’t supported here, or the file is damaged.
inlineMediaError: Can’t play this file in this browser. Use the original file card to download or open it.
inlineNotDelivered: This file isn’t in the loaded deliveries for this conversation.
